title: Scotland's National Animal Is the Unicorn
description: Scotland chose a mythical creature as its national animal, and it has been a symbol there for centuries.

scenes.text: The national animal of Scotland is the unicorn.
scenes.subject: unicorn
scenes.say: [laughs] The national animal of Scotland is... the UNICORN.

scenes.text: It has been a Scottish symbol for hundreds of years, and it appeared on the royal coat of arms.
scenes.subject: castle
scenes.say: It has been a Scottish symbol for hundreds of years, and it appeared on the royal coat of arms.

scenes.text: In old stories, the unicorn stood for purity, strength and pride, and it was said that only a king could tame one.
scenes.subject: unicorn
scenes.say: [whispers] In old stories, the unicorn stood for purity, strength and pride, and it was said that only a king could tame one.

scenes.text: Many old carvings show the unicorn in chains, a sign of how wild and powerful it was believed to be.
